questions.q2: What is the lowest pitch sounding at the very start (offset 0) of bar 3, in any staff (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q3: What is the highest pitch attacked in bar 15, across all staves (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q4: List every bar (other than bar 1) in which voice 1.1 is identical (same notes and durations) to voice 1.1 of bar 1.
questions.q5: How many notes are attacked in staff 2 of bar 8, all voices of that staff? Count each note of a chord separately; exclude grace notes.
questions.q6: In voice 2.2, across bars 21 to 24, what are the lowest and the highest pitch (grace notes excluded)? As {"low": …, "high": …}.
questions.q7: How many times is the pitch F3 attacked in voice 2.1 in bars 14 and 15 together (grace notes excluded)?
questions.q8: List the attacks of voice 1.1 in bar 2 in order (grace notes excluded); write a chord as its pitches joined by + low to high, e.g. "C4+E4".
